title: Hereford Inlet Lighthouse, North Wildwood
geometryBasis: The two named mapped ways fix the connected keeper residence and square tower. Six exact July 2023 Qualla originals control yellow clapboards, pale porch trim, stair rails, red brick, projecting gables and dark lantern.
sectionBasis: The keeper house and porch follow the independent approach grade. The lantern top uses approximately 49.5 feet above the approach as the architectural scale control.
limitations: July 2023 keeper house and tower. The lantern is unlit and interiors, surrounding gardens and separate buildings are outside the model.
Secondary roof joins, rail and bracket carving, and exact local thresholds are approximate where the cleared photos provide incomplete coverage.
Original terrain samples are retained. The entrance and rear steps are approximate fits to that source field.
